title: Ufficio del fango dataset (13th-14th centuries)
descriptions: The data for this layer was collected by Prof. Guy Geltner from the Archivio di Stato di Bologna, Podestà, Ufficio delle acque, strade, ponti, calanchi, seliciate e fango. This layer was produced during the ERC project ‘Healthscaping Urban Europe: Bio‐Power, Space and Society, 1200‐1500’ (n° 724114).
